title: Fixing cross-loop socket reuse in Redis async cluster transactions
description: How we diagnosed and fixed two subtle asyncio event-loop bugs (#4513 & #4537) in redis/redis-py when queuing lazy and movablekeys commands on ClusterPipeline.
heroAlt: Diagram of async RedisCluster pipeline isolating worker-thread event loop sockets from caller loop pools.
html:
How we diagnosed and fixed two subtle asyncio event-loop bugs (#4513 & #4537) in redis/redis-py when queuing lazy and movablekeys commands on ClusterPipeline.

The Problem in Production

Every architecture decision in OPEN SOURCE · REDIS came from real production constraints: either an asyncio event loop deadlocking under cluster load, a runaway token bill crossing thousands of dollars, or a wholesale merchant needing sub-second Urdu/Pashto voice billing.

How We Engineered the Fix

By fixing the owning layer directly, adding deterministic regression suites, and verifying exact bytes in production, we turned fragile prototypes into durable production systems.
